description: [Wicked Reputation] Search/rank registered agents by tier, stake, reputation or slash history. Every filter is a typed query param.

founding_member.description: True to only show founding members.

min_slash_count.description: Minimum slash events (1 finds agents ever slashed).

sort.description: stake_amount | reputation_score | slash_count | registered_at, prefixed "-" (desc, default) or "+" (asc).

name: reputation_query
